python3 -c "
total_marketable = 1176556
treasury_bills = 356798
treasury_bonds = 158070

not_bonds_bills = total_marketable - treasury_bills - treasury_bonds
percentage = (not_bonds_bills / total_marketable) * 100
print(f'Not bonds and bills: {not_bonds_bills}')
print(f'Percentage: {percentage:.2f}')
"
